fails: Text is below 4.5:1 against what's behind it (3:1 for large text), in every color scheme. Text over images, gradients or blends is reported for review instead of guessed.
A button, link-as-button or input is smaller than 24px, or 44px on screens 640px wide or less.
A button that shows only an icon has no accessible name.
An input has no label, or its text is under 16px on a phone, which makes iOS zoom in on focus.
Something is wider than the screen at 390px, text is clipped, or a fixed element or open dialog sits off-screen.
A font size isn't one of the sizes in the policy's type scale.
Interface text uses a font that isn't in the policy (code, kbd and pre are excluded).
A paragraph runs wider than 75 characters (or the policy's limit).
All-caps text has no positive tracking, or display text (32px and up) has positive tracking.
Numbers in table cells (or marked data-critly-number) don't use tabular figures, or a numeric column isn't end-aligned.
The html element has no background, or it differs from the body's, so overscroll shows a different color.
An element uses transition: all.
A running animation or transition moves width, height, top, left, margin or padding instead of transform.
An image has no width and height or aspect-ratio, or an image above the fold is lazy-loaded.
The page shows lorem ipsum, "John Doe", TODO, or a phrase the policy bans.
A gap or padding isn't on the policy's spacing scale. Opt-in until it's proven quiet on real apps.
A text, background or border color matches none of the app's color tokens. Opt-in until it's proven quiet on real apps.
A rounded surface inside another, at an even inset, doesn't use outer radius minus inset. Opt-in until it's proven quiet on real apps.
Tabbing to a control changes nothing visible, or the focused control is covered.
With reduced motion on, transform or position animations still run.
The page shifts more than 0.1 (CLS) while it loads.
An open dialog doesn't move focus in, keep it there, or return it on close.
